related.title: Android Verified Boot：信任鏈與回滾索引
related.titleEn: Android Verified Boot: trust chains and rollback indices
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：90%與95%依兩條件交集計數，不公開秘密；FileVault與安全開機能力分欄，不互相冒充。 交付200台合成覆蓋表、復原權限矩陣與平台差異說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compute 90% and 95% from the two-condition intersection without exposing secrets; keep FileVault and secure-boot evidence in separate fields. Deliver synthetic 200-device coverage, recovery permissions and platform distinctions.
related.difference: 用合成bootloader、vbmeta與分割區清單畫驗證鏈；分開標示簽章有效、裝置鎖定狀態與rollback index，不對真實手機解鎖或刷機。
related.differenceEn: Map bootloader, vbmeta and partitions from synthetic records; distinguish signature validity, device lock state and rollback index without unlocking or flashing a real phone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可驗證管理覆蓋=同時符合加密政策與復原託管證據的裝置/範圍裝置；兩者缺一都不能算完整。 200台教學Mac中180台同時具政策與託管驗證，其餘20台缺一項。 180/200×100=90%；補修10台後190/200×100=95%。
教學回滾判定要求候選index≥已記錄最低index，且簽章與其他驗證通過；差值是索引間距，不是安全強度或版本年齡。 已儲存最低index=7，候選index=10；兩者均為同一rollback位置的整數。 候選高出10−7=3個索引單位；候選改8時高出1個；候選6則應拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Verified management coverage is devices meeting both encryption policy and recovery-escrow evidence divided by in-scope devices; either missing part is incomplete. Of 200 teaching Macs, 180 have both policy and escrow evidence and 20 lack one requirement. 180/200×100=90%; completing ten yields 190/200×100=95%.

The teaching rollback rule requires candidate index≥stored minimum plus valid signatures and other checks; index difference is neither strength nor version age. Stored minimum index is 7 and candidate is 10, both integers for the same rollback location. Candidate margin is 10−7=3 index units; candidate 8 gives one, while candidate 6 must be rejected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OSV：鎖定檔與弱點適用性解析
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：90%與95%依兩條件交集計數，不公開秘密；FileVault與安全開機能力分欄，不互相冒充。 交付200台合成覆蓋表、復原權限矩陣與平台差異說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compute 90% and 95% from the two-condition intersection without exposing secrets; keep FileVault and secure-boot evidence in separate fields. Deliver synthetic 200-device coverage, recovery permissions and platform distinctions.
related.difference: 將套件名稱、生態系、版本與修復區間分欄，追到直接或遞移依賴的根節點。
related.differenceEn: Separate ecosystem, package, version and fixed range, then trace direct or transitive dependencies to roots.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 可驗證管理覆蓋=同時符合加密政策與復原託管證據的裝置/範圍裝置；兩者缺一都不能算完整。 200台教學Mac中180台同時具政策與託管驗證，其餘20台缺一項。 180/200×100=90%；補修10台後190/200×100=95%。
受影響元件比例=符合公告範圍的唯一元件/盤點元件；公告數不等於受影響部署數。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 鎖定檔有40個唯一元件，8個落在合成公告範圍，其中3個是直接依賴、5個是遞移依賴。 受影響比例=8/40=20%；需追蹤5條遞移修復路徑。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Verified management coverage is devices meeting both encryption policy and recovery-escrow evidence divided by in-scope devices; either missing part is incomplete. Of 200 teaching Macs, 180 have both policy and escrow evidence and 20 lack one requirement. 180/200×100=90%; completing ten yields 190/200×100=95%.

Affected-component fraction counts unique matching components, not advisories or deployed instances. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A lockfile contains forty unique components; eight match synthetic ranges, comprising three direct and five transitive dependencies. Affected fraction=8/40=20%; five transitive remediation paths need tracing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
